newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian troops kill at least 10 separatists.
newsitem.headline: Indian troops kill at least 10 separatists.

text.p: Indian soldiers shot dead at least 10 separatist guerrillas in two separate encounters in the northeastern state of Assam on Thursday, an Indian defence spokesman said.
Seven separatists of the National Democratic Front of Bodoland were killed in Tarabari village of Darang district, the spokesman said.
In another incident, three guerrillas of the United Liberation Front of Asom were killed by paramilitary troops in Hindugopa village of the same district, he added.
Several separatist groups have been fighting in the northeastern region for independent homelands.
